title: Schema.org
authority: Schema.org (W3C Community Group; Google, Microsoft, Yahoo, Yandex)
usedFor: Universal web fallback — generic metadata, dates, ratings, observations. Already referenced as the `schema:` prefix in this project's JSON-LD context.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey. Schema.org's own terms page has not been read for the terms we use.
finding: This project's JSON-LD context already maps `createdAt -> schema:dateCreated` and `updatedAt -> schema:dateModified` with no provenance record. Both are plausible and neither is verified. `dateCreated`/`dateModified` carry Schema.org's own semantics about a CreativeWork, and whether those match a passport record's lifecycle timestamps is exactly the kind of near-miss that a machine consumer acts on and a human never re-reads.
nextStep: Read Schema.org's definitions of `dateCreated` and `dateModified` and decide whether they mean what our lifecycle timestamps mean. If they do not, the honest move is a `urn:odal-node:` term, not a close-enough borrow.
